title: SQLite insert_entry: duplicate check outside transaction (TOCTOU)
description: group_log/sqlite_storage.rs:51-63: duplicate check runs outside transaction scope. Between the check and tx.begin(), another task can insert the same entry_id; a concurrent insert causes a DB error instead of DuplicateEntry. Also: if a parent CID insertion fails mid-transaction, the main entry row exists but parent rows do not. Fix: move tx.begin() before the duplicate check so the check and both inserts are in one transaction.
